rsvp_save_failed: Couldn't save — tap to try again.
invite_landing_intro: You have been invited to join {db} on mvox.
invite_landing_choose_provider: Sign in to accept the invitation:
invite_landing_expired_warning: This invite appears to have expired on {date}. You can still try — the server has the final say.
invite_error_invalid: This invite link is not valid. Check that you copied the whole link, or ask your administrator for a new one.
invite_error_dead: This invite could not be redeemed. It may have expired or already been used. Ask your administrator for a new invite.
invite_error_conflict: Your sign-in is already linked to a different account in this collective, so the invite could not be applied. You are signed in with your existing account.
invite_error_unexpected: Something inconsistent happened while redeeming the invite. Ask your administrator to verify your account.
invite_error_failed: Redeeming the invite failed. You can try again from this page.
admin_invite_no_collective: Select a collective before creating invites.
admin_invite_no_access: Creating invites requires administrator rights this account does not appear to have.
admin_invite_bearer_warning: Anyone who opens this link can claim this membership — it is a bearer secret. Send it only to {email}, over a channel you trust.
admin_invite_show_once: This link is shown only once and is not stored anywhere. It expires on {date}.
admin_invite_partial_failure: A person entity ({personId}) was already created and carries a live invite token. Do not send any link — repair or remove that person entity in Entu, then try again.
profile_intro: Fill in as much or as little as you like at each visibility level. Each level is saved on its own.
profile_no_collective: Select a collective to edit your profile.
profile_level_public_hint: Visible to anyone, including people outside your collective.
profile_level_domain_hint: Visible to everyone in your collective.
